name: Consulting Report
tagline: Strategy-firm style deliverable on pure white: full-sentence action titles, a section tracker, source lines and dense, orderly CSS charts. Original slides-commons design.

palette.description: pure white canvas, deep navy for titles and the focus series, a ladder of navy tints for every other series, and one restrained teal accent reserved for the so-what (the highlighted bar, row, option or callout)

typography.style: semibold transitional serif for full-sentence action titles and section numerals; a neutral grotesque with tabular figures for body, tables, chart labels, trackers and source lines

best_for: Decks that must prove a recommendation with evidence: strategy and steering-committee reviews, business cases, market and cost diagnostics, options assessments and implementation plans. Built for many numbers per slide: column, stacked, waterfall and 2x2 charts, data tables, Harvey-ball option grids and Gantt roadmaps.
avoid_for: Inspirational keynotes, product launches, brand storytelling and anything that needs imagery or emotion. Sparse slides with one big word look empty in this system.
navigation: inline script (arrow keys, space, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, mouse wheel, click, swipe)
